scripts.deploy: node tooling/validate-production-deploy.ts && vite build --mode production && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.test: vitest run --config vitest.client.config.ts && vitest run --config vitest.worker.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc --project tsconfig.client.json --noEmit && tsc --project tsconfig.worker.json --noEmit && tsc --project tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit && tsc --project tsconfig.tools.json --noEmit
